title: Shift Uniform 2d Plane Scale
description: When holding shift on two dimensional scales in infinite world gumball, scale same factor in both directions.
summary: Holding Shift during 2D plane gumball scale (scaleXY/scaleYZ/scaleXZ) now applies the same factor to both in-plane axes, using radial distance in the plane. Shift can be toggled mid-drag via existing key listeners. Added unit tests for uniform plane scale factors.
